comment: Single populated 19x16 stripboard with three on-board 20k bias trimmers, four J201 JFETs, six pots and a DPDT on/on/on channel switch drawn beside the board. Pot tapers given as Log and converted to A. The electrolytic is printed 320uF, an unusual value.
uncertain: Electrolytic at column 10, rows G-I: clearly printed '320uF', a non-standard value (possibly meant 220uF); recorded as printed
5nF and 500pF are printed as such (non-standard values, usually 4.7nF / 470pF); recorded as printed
rows: bias Q1 and Q2 to 6.5V, Q3 to 5V
